title: Glass Shelf 16-Inch Double Tier with Towel Bar, Wall Mount Solid Brass Gallery Rail Allied Brass
body_html:
Add streamlined storage with a 16-Inch wall-mount glass shelf featuring a double-tier layout, a solid brass gallery rail, and an integrated towel bar—crafted to coordinate with the waverly place collection of transitional bath accessories.

  • Double-tier glass shelving keeps essentials organized and within reach
  • 3/8-Inch tempered glass for safety and strength
  • Solid brass gallery rail helps keep items secure
  • Integrated towel bar adds convenient towel storage
  • Wall mount with concealed screws for a clean, finished look

Specs

  • Overall size: 16 in L x 12 in H
  • Projection (depth): 5 in
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 in (3/8 in) tempered glass
  • Material: brass hardware
  • Weight capacity: 4 lb
  • Mounting type: wall mount
  • Included: glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Assembly required: false
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finish options: multiple designer finish options available for matching waverly place and versatile bath accessories styling

_previous.title: 16 Inch Gallery Double Glass Shelf with Towel Bar
_previous.description: Add a flare of style to your décor with this decorative glass shelf. Shelf can be used anywhere in the home for a great space to store your products. Gallery rail will keep your items secure while the integrated towel bar provides a creative space for your towels. Tempered glass is 3/8 Inches thick and all of the hardware is made of solid brass and finished with the highest quality materials to provide a lifetime of beauty.
